title: Kitchari
subtitle: spiced rice and lentil pot
description: A one-pot dish of basmati rice and red lentils cooked with garlic, cumin and turmeric. Organic lentils break down less during cooking; for a red version, stir in tomato paste after frying the garlic.

steps.text: Rinse the rice and lentils in a bowl under running water until the water runs clear. Cover with room-temperature water and soak for 10 minutes, then drain.
Fry the chopped garlic in the oil in a pot until lightly golden. For the red version, add the tomato paste now and stir for a few seconds.
Add the rice, lentils, salt, cumin, turmeric and allspice, pour in water to 1 cm above the rice and lentils, and bring to the boil.
Cook on high heat for about 20 minutes until the water has completely evaporated.
Turn off the heat, cover the pot and leave to rest for 20 minutes.
